maria: Quick security check: we're onboarding a new external connector. Is it okay to store its long-lived service credential in SSM SecureString (KMS CMK) or should we create a Vault dynamic role and issue short-lived creds? Also, any redaction concerns for env vars that the connector will print at startup?

jonathan: Prefer Vault dynamic creds if the connector supports rotation. Short-lived reduces blast radius. SSM is ok for static secrets but needs strict IAM + rotation automation.

leo: Agree. If we must use SSM, ensure the parameter is SecureString with a customer CMK and a key policy that only the connector's role can Decrypt. Tag it and enable automatic rotation (we have a rotation lambda we can reuse).

infra-bot: Rotation lambda snippet:

```
aws ssm put-parameter --name "/prod/connectors/acme/creds" --type SecureString --value "${NEW_SECRET}" --key-id "alias/redwood-ssm-cmk" --overwrite
```

Make sure to include kms:ViaService condition in the key policy and restrict principals.

sec-bot: Note: our logging agent strips values matching the pattern `SERVICE_*|PASSWORD|TOKEN` from stdout by default, but that only applies to services registered in the redaction list. If the connector uses a non-standard env var name, add it to the redaction list (or use explicit redact API).

alice: Who signs off on KMS key grants to external connectors? We need an approval step if it's an external party.

tim: For external vendor access we require a security review + ticket in #compliance with DRI + product signoff. I can prep an approval template. Also recommend HSM-backed KMS for high-value credentials (on-prem or sensitive workloads).

maria: Thanks — action items: (1) try Vault dynamic creds (DRI @maria), (2) if fallback to SSM, use SecureString + CMK + restrictive key policy + rotation lambda (DRI @leo), (3) add any non-standard env var names to log redaction list (DRI @jonathan), (4) open compliance ticket for external grants (DRI @alice).

jonathan: :thumbsup: I'll test dynamic creds this afternoon and ping here if any API gaps.

alice: I'll start the compliance ticket and attach the external access checklist.

leo: I'll draft the key policy and a PR for the rotation lambda.

maria: Excellent, thanks everyone — I’ll update the onboarding doc with the final choice and link the ticket.
